create_MixedStrategy: create a MixedStrategy instance that combines multiple inner maximization solvers with weighted outputs
run_MixedStrategy_solve_max: run MixedStrategy.solve_max to solve inner maximization with a combination of solvers and return the weighted final value
build_MixedStrategy_init_params: build initial inner maximization dual variables and their types by calling MixedStrategy.init_layer_inner_params
test_MixedStrategy_stochastic: test whether MixedStrategy supports stochastic parameters by checking all underlying solvers
review_MixedStrategy_class: review the MixedStrategy class that solves inner maximizations with a weighted combination of solvers
